title: Restricted DIVDRA Spatial Distribution Runtime Binding
goal: Bind the already-qualified single-level positive DIVDRA spatial distribution process to the current runtime forcing seam without reopening drainage science.

inputs: externally computed nonnegative scalar soil-to-drain transfer
binding_contract.output: exactly one drainage level row compatible with fmr_b110_physical_forcing_t%drainage_flux_by_level
binding_contract.scratch: temporary process result and matrix are call/job local
binding_contract.mutation_rule: materialize into temporary storage and publish only after DRAIN_DIST_OK; reject if target drainage forcing is already allocated
binding_contract.hydraulic_view_rule: no committed-state lookup inside the binding; provenance of the explicit hydraulic view remains external
binding_contract.solver_rule: no solver Jacobian access or mutation

exit_gates: runtime materialization has shape 1 x active_nodes
materialized node row is bit-identical to direct call of the qualified process for the same explicit inputs
current source/sink provider consumes the materialized row unchanged as a positive sink
zero scalar path is admitted and materializes zero row
process failure status propagates without publishing target forcing
preallocated target drainage forcing is rejected without overwrite
different explicit hydraulic views produce the corresponding process outputs without committed-state capture
O0 and O2 test output identical
no reference source delta and no production delta outside the new runtime binding
non_goals: requalify DIVDRA equations or Lev2Comp seam
read committed state inside the binding
modify the Richards solver or source/sink provider
next_after_owner_closeout: independent runtime qualification, then separate canonical admission if qualified
